summary_of_bug:
ToStringBuilder/ToStringStyle is leaking its ThreadLocal registry: after reflection-based toString operations, especially on object/array cycles and hierarchy traversal, the per-thread registry is not cleared. The failing tests all end with validateNullToStringStyleRegistry(), showing that even when string output is otherwise correct for cycles, arrays, and inherited fields, the ThreadLocal remains populated.

This matches LANG-586: ToStringStyle creates a ThreadLocal used for cycle detection but never removes it, which can retain webapp classloader references and cause memory leaks on container reload. The bug is therefore missing cleanup of the ToStringStyle registry after toString/reflectionToString processing completes.

LANG-574.label: P
LANG-574.reason: Strong regional signal: same `org.apache.commons.lang3.builder` subsystem and specifically `HashCodeBuilder`, which is named alongside `ToStringStyle` in the current leak report. There is also some mechanism adjacency because both involve reflection-based builder logic and array/object handling. However, the past issue is about performance in `append(Object)` / `reflectionAppend(Object)` and array type dispatch, not ThreadLocal lifecycle or registry cleanup. Useful for warming up the builder package, but not a direct pointer to the leak root cause.

LANG-575.label: P
LANG-575.reason: Good regional and moderate mechanism overlap. This report is again in `org.apache.commons.lang3.builder.HashCodeBuilder`, and specifically in `reflectionAppend`, which is closer to the reflection-heavy failing tests around `ToStringBuilder.reflectionToString(...)`. The current failures mention cycle handling and registry cleanup (`validateNullToStringStyleRegistry()`), so reflection internals in builder classes are relevant context. Still, the actual issue here is unnecessary copying of `excludeFields`, not ThreadLocal registration/removal, so it is only partially relevant.

LANG-581.label: I
LANG-581.reason: No meaningful regional or mechanism overlap. This is a Javadoc/documentation issue in `StringUtils.removeEndIgnoreCase()`, outside the builder package and unrelated to reflection, cycle detection, arrays, or ThreadLocal-based registries. It provides essentially no diagnostic signal for localizing the current `ToStringStyle`/`HashCodeBuilder` memory leak.
